main_owner_objective: OPEN: faithful historical source reading, candidate rules separate, eventual independent blinded real-human evaluation

source.title: Paulus Alexandrinus Eisagogika, Greek text as presented by Eulogikon
source.method: Direct access and search of complete site-marked-down Greek body; original Greek clauses compared with frozen C04/C05 calculations; not a scanned printed critical apparatus

clauses.source_locator: Greek body §ε; Eulogikon web line 75, markdown marker 18
clauses.short_exact: καὶ τὰ λεπτὰ ὡς μοῖραν μίαν
clauses.meaning: Count the remaining arcminutes as part of one ordinal degree within the sign-based sevenfold method, not as a zero-based source number.
clauses.computational_boundary: C04 sign_monomoiria already implements physical completed-degree intervals [n°, (n+1)°); boundary 0°00' -> first ordinal degree, 0°35' still first. Do not describe C18 truncated comparison as universally the written Paulus ch5 method.

clauses.source_locator: Greek body §λβ; Eulogikon web line 303, markdown marker 86
clauses.meaning: Chapter-32 trigonal allotment is formed for the degree of the LIGHT OF SECT (Sun by day; Moon by night), rather than every natal point, Ascendant or planet indiscriminately.
clauses.computational_boundary: Only a source-aware research wrapper for actual sect luminary is admitted; do not apply C05 function to arbitrary natal points without a separate textual rule.

clauses.source_locator: Greek body §λβ; Eulogikon web line 303, markdown marker 86
clauses.meaning: Avoid a second allotment to an already-used planet until the sequence reaches its source-planet return condition; explains why later duplicate Venus should be skipped in the seven-distinct-planet narrative.
clauses.computational_boundary: Conflicting manuscript diagram family with duplicate Venus remains literal witnessed evidence, not automatically corrected.

clauses.source_locator: Greek body §λβ; Eulogikon web line 304, markdown marker 87
clauses.meaning: The subjoined canonical table is described as FOR DAYTIME NATIVITIES and the nightly trigon ruler order is reversed, with Jupiter then Sun in the fire trigon.
clauses.computational_boundary: This line describes the literary table; it does not certify night/day scope of every later manuscript chart until their own rubrics are independently read.

chapter33.source_locator: Greek body §λγ; Eulogikon web lines 305-309, markdown markers 88-91
chapter33.meaning: Discusses reconstructing Ascendant degree using the sect light trigonal monomoiria, and names alternative procedures involving Moon's terms and prenatal syzygy. This is distinct from evaluating a known arbitrary point's monomoiria.

missing_digital_table_rows.described_by_source: Embedded textual rendition of the 30×4 canonical trigon chart prints triplicity sign-group headings, but the fetched markdown between canonical-chart heading and night-sect sentence contains no legible per-degree planetary rows.
missing_digital_table_rows.absence_scope: DIGITAL_MARKDOWN_RENDITION_ONLY; no claim original Greek manuscripts or printed Boer table had no cells
